title: PhilGEPS procurement records, Panabo City, 2022
source: PhilGEPS open data (Philippine Government Electronic Procurement System)
notes: Each record is one line item of a PhilGEPS notice, with its award if any.
Approved Budget of the Contract repeats on every line item of the same notice. Count it once per notice, not once per record.
Contract Amount repeats on every line item of the same award. Count it once per award (award_reference_no), not once per record.
quarter is the quarterly PhilGEPS file the record came from. source_row is its row number in that file (header = row 1).
Changes from the source: dates -> YYYY-MM-DD (times dropped); "NULL" and blank cells -> null; text trimmed; budget, amount and quantity as numbers.
Field names are the source column names in snake_case. See "fields" for the original names.
Some quarter files have no header row; the header of another quarter of the same year was used (same column count).
One quarter uses the old PhilGEPS format: some columns were renamed to the newer names, and personal data columns were removed. See "quarters". Fields a quarter does not have are null.
13 rows are exact copies of another row in the same file. They are kept, with duplicate_of_row set to that row's source_row; skip them when counting line items.

Q2.header: no header row in the file; used the header of another quarter of the same year

Q4.header: no header row in the file; used the header of another quarter of the same year

Q1.filter: Old PhilGEPS format with no City/Municipality column. Kept rows where the Procuring Entity name contains "PANABO", or the entity is filed under Panabo City in the other quarterly files.

fields.duplicate_of_row: source_row of the row this one is an exact copy of (null if none)
